text: Healthy living means taking care of your body and mind. First, eat a balanced diet with plenty of fruit, vegetables, and whole grains. Try to limit sugary drinks and fast food. Second, exercise regularly. Even a short walk every day can make a big difference. Third, get enough sleep, because your body needs rest to stay strong. Don't forget mental health: talk to friends, relax, and ask for help when you feel stressed. Finally, keep a good work-life balance. Spend time on hobbies and with family. These simple habits can help you feel happier and healthier every day.
